name: espectre-core
description: Wi-Fi CSI motion detection engine from ESPectre (https://github.com/francescopace/espectre), ported to run standalone on plain Arduino-ESP32 - no ESPHome/Home Assistant required. Exposes CSI capture, gain locking, NBVI band auto-calibration, and MVS/ML motion detectors through a begin()/loop() API for any Arduino/PlatformIO sketch, including FreeInk SDK firmware.
